import pytest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
from nexus_os.bridge.browser_http_diagnostic import BrowserHTTPDiagnosticRelay

@pytest.fixture
def relay():
    r = BrowserHTTPDiagnosticRelay(bridge_url="http://127.0.0.1:7354")
    r.token_budget_checker = MagicMock(return_value=True)
    r.approval_checker = MagicMock(return_value=True)
    return r

def test_dry_run_allowed_returns_gross_args_no_transport_call(relay):
    with patch.object(relay, "invoke") as mock_invoke:
        result = relay.execute_governed(
            url="https://huggingface.co/api/models",
            method="GET",
            dry_run=True,
        )
        assert result["status"] == "planned"
        assert "gross_arguments" in result or "prepared" in str(result).lower()
        mock_invoke.assert_not_called()

def test_live_allowed_calls_fake_transport_exactly_once(relay):
    with patch.object(relay, "invoke", return_value={"status": "ok", "body": "live"}) as mock_invoke:
        result = relay.execute_governed(
            url="https://huggingface.co/api/models",
            method="GET",
            dry_run=False,
        )
        assert result["status"] == "ok"
        mock_invoke.assert_called_once()

def test_host_blocked_calls_transport_zero_times(relay):
    with patch.object(relay, "invoke") as mock_invoke:
        # force block via policy (existing validate raises or we simulate)
        with patch.object(relay, "validate_browser_diagnostic_request", side_effect=ValueError("blocked")):
            result = relay.execute_governed(url="https://evil.example.com", dry_run=False)
            assert result.get("status") in ("blocked", "error")
            mock_invoke.assert_not_called()

def test_method_blocked_calls_transport_zero_times(relay):
    with patch.object(relay, "invoke") as mock_invoke:
        result = relay.execute_governed(
            url="https://huggingface.co/api/models",
            method="POST",  # blocked by policy/ALLOWED_METHODS
            dry_run=False,
        )
        assert result.get("status") in ("blocked", "error")
        mock_invoke.assert_not_called()

def test_auth_cookie_xapikey_headers_stripped(relay):
    dirty = {"Authorization": "Bearer x", "Cookie": "a=1", "X-Api-Key": "secret", "Accept": "json"}
    clean = relay._sanitize_headers(dirty)
    assert "authorization" not in {k.lower() for k in clean}
    assert "cookie" not in {k.lower() for k in clean}
    assert "x-api-key" not in {k.lower() for k in clean}
    assert clean.get("Accept") == "json"

def test_token_budget_denied_blocks_before_transport(relay):
    relay.token_budget_checker.return_value = False
    with patch.object(relay, "invoke") as mock_invoke:
        result = relay.execute_governed(
            url="https://huggingface.co/api/models",
            dry_run=False,
        )
        assert result["status"] == "blocked"
        assert "token_budget" in result["reason"].lower()
        mock_invoke.assert_not_called()

def test_approval_required_for_nonread_blocks_before_transport(relay):
    relay.approval_checker.return_value = False
    with patch.object(relay, "invoke") as mock_invoke:
        result = relay.execute_governed(
            url="https://huggingface.co/api/models",
            method="GET",
            intent="write",
            dry_run=False,
        )
        assert result["status"] == "require_approval"
        mock_invoke.assert_not_called()

def test_jsonrpc_a2a_bridge_error_is_surfaced(relay):
    with patch.object(relay, "invoke", side_effect=RuntimeError("JSON-RPC error from 7354")):
        result = relay.execute_governed(
            url="https://huggingface.co/api/models",
            dry_run=False,
        )
        assert result.get("status") == "error" or "error" in str(result).lower()
